How do I sync my transactions?
In the Settings section, enable the cloud sync option. Your data is automatically stored on Google Drive.
Does fintrak have access to a bank account?
No, fintrak only records transactions by reading Bank texts (with your permission) or manually entering them.
How do I create a savings goal?
Go to the Tools section and select the savings goals option. Then you can define a new goal with a specific amount and date with the + button.

How do we build goals that we really achieve?

The goal of SMART is to abbreviate five words:\N1. Specific: tell me exactly what you want.\N2. Measurable: determine the exact amount.\N3. Achievable: be realistic about your income.\N4. Related: align with the values of your life.\N5. Time-bound: set a deadline.
Your roadmap to getting rid of monetary concerns

The stages of financial independence are:\N1. Dependence: expenses greater than income.\N2. Survival: covering expenses without savings.\N3. Stability: the creation of an emergency fund.\N4. Debt relief: settling all bad loans.\N5. Security: passive income for essential expenses.\N6. Independence: passive income for the desired lifestyle.
Smart asset distribution to reduce risk

A healthy financial basket consists of three parts:\N1. Security basket: liquidity and emergency fund for relaxation.\N2. Growth basket: investing in stock exchanges, gold and currency to increase wealth.\N3. Basket of wishes: saving for big purchases and fun.the balance between these is the key to your success.
